explanation: Erdos445Prop c p n says there are a, b ∈ (n, n + p^c) with ab ≡ 1 (mod p), matching erdosproblems.com/445. Question: for any c > 1/2 and all sufficiently large primes p, does this hold for every n ≥ 0? The statement quantifies exactly so: for each c > 1/2, eventually in p, primality of p implies the property for all n. Faithful.
